decisions.reason: The aloe vera line sits close to the established offer and has its own page, so it signals strong commitment, and the firm has no evidence of a shortfall against aspirations that would prompt problemistic search.

A hyaluronic serum is a staple of the facial care range and fits the existing production at low cost, so carrying it while results are still uncertain is reasonable for a small established manufacturer.
A cleansing milk complements the facial routine with shared ingredients and processes, and with no reported underperformance there is no trigger to withdraw it within a year.
